answer: Game theory: bonded identity with insider defection. Each agent stakes a 50 USDC bond; proven fraud burns it, half to whoever files signed proof - even the sybil's own clone. 200 identities lock 10,000 USDC, any clone can defect for 25, so the operator must bribe every key 25 per epoch: 5,000/epoch, more than the fleet earns, while 20 convictions burn the stake. Steps: 1) lock 50 to join; 2) peers flag forged work; 3) a jury checks; 4) the bond burns, 25 to the reporter. Bonds are marble vaults along a river of escrow: each floats a stone, and a beacon report sinks a forged one instantly.
